blocks.text: Cricket update: Lloyd pays tribute to 'greatest' Sobers at funeral. Sir Garfield Sobers is called the "greatest all-round cricketer the world has ever known" by former team-mate Sir Clive Lloyd at the legendary West Indies player's state funeral in Barbados.
